title: The Memory You Want to Preserve Accurately
short_teaser: Writing details soon after an event can protect them from later simplification.
story: Writing details soon after an event can protect them from later simplification. Reflection can preserve complexity rather than replacing it with a neat story. Reflection turns experience into guidance rather than leaving it as an unexamined memory. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Reflection can preserve complexity rather than replacing it with a neat story. Reflection turns experience into guidance rather than leaving it as an unexamined memory.
spark_application: Write one lesson worth keeping and one thing you may do differently. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
